name: Dr. Vikramjit Singh Sahney
education: Public Leadership Credential from Harvard Kennedy School, U.S.A., M.A. (Economics), Doctor of Literature (Honoris Causa) from Punjabi University, Patiala, Masters Degree in Economics and Business Administration from Punjab University
permanent_address: House No. 140, Block A, Sector 5, ECO CITY 1 New Chandigarh, VIII-Mullanpur Guribdass, SAS Nagar, Punjab- 140901
books: (i) Jewels of Punjab, Vol. 1 and 2 and (ii) Baba Banda Singh Bahadur
social_activities: Highly acclaimed humanitarian, social activist and philanthropist; International President, World Punjabi Organisation (WPO); Chairman, Sun Foundation, a leading NGO dedicated towards skill development of the youth and empowering women in India; running world class skill centres in Punjab and Delhi along with drug de-addiction and rehabilitation centres; the Sun Foundation has also arranged for emergency evacuation and rehabilitation of Afghan Sikhs and Hindu refugees, providing their daily livelihoods, medical insurance and skill development of children; organised various socio-cultural events to promote ties between India-U.A.E., India-U.K. and India-South Africa
hobbies: Accomplished Sufi singer by hobby with several chartbusters; occasional indulgence in composing poetry and watching recreational sports like golf and polo
countries_visited: Switzerland, to attend the World Economic Forum meet, 2022; U.A.E., to attend the Dubai Expo, 2021; Saudi Arabia, to attend the Janadriyadh Festival, 2017; United Kingdom, to attend the U.K.-India, year of Culture, 2017; China and South Africa to attend the Brics Summit, 2017 and 2018 respectively; Muscat, to attend the World Punjabi Organisation, 2018
other_information: Former Honorary Consul for Republic of South Africa; Chair of BRICS AGRI Business Council and Member of Board of Trade; Board Member, National Skill Development Corporation & IBEF, Government of India; Former President, (i) ICC, Paris and (ii) SAARC Chamber of Commerce; has represented India in various International Conferences; conferred, (i) Padma Shri, by the President of India, (ii) International Peace Award, by Sir Anerood Jugnauth, Hon'ble President of Mauritius, (iii) Leadership Award, (iv) Raja Ram Mohan Roy Award for Women Upliftment, (v) Rashtriya Gaurav Award, (vi) Mother India International Award, (vii) Arch of India Gold Award, (viii) India Community Services Award, (ix) Millennium Sikh Award, 2001, by Shri L.K. Advani, (x) IMM Top Professional Manager Award 1996, by Shri P. Chidambaram, (xi) Outstanding Achievement Award, by the Chief Minister of Punjab and (xii) a Memento by Sir Edmund Hillary, and several other awards
